description: The suite selection: runs only the entry files of the suite list that a change can affect, each under the recording step, in Linux shards and one Windows job, and reuses the passed results of a pull request. `suites` names the suite list, which states the suites, the setups with one script each and the jobs' runner labels. `language-steps` names the language steps that the first Linux shard runs after its entry files. `pinned-tools` names the pinned tools, `node` and `gitleaks`: each is a setup of that name which the suite jobs give, on Linux and on Windows, at the version of the pins file of the revision of Shared Workflows that the run uses, Gitleaks after the sha256 check of its asset. A suite states a pinned tool under `setups`, or an entry file under `entry_setups`, as any other setup, and only the entry files that state it get it; the suite list defines no setup of that name, and none with `tool: node` beside `node`. The check of the configuration file fails on another name and on a name stated twice. The selection fails when the suite list defines a setup with the name of a pinned tool, when a setup states `tool: node` beside `node`, and, as for an undefined setup, when a suite states `node` or `gitleaks` that neither the suite list nor `pinned-tools` knows. A job fails before any entry file runs when the Gitleaks asset has another sha256 than the pins file states, and when the pins file holds no asset of the tool for the job's system. Invented example: {"suites": "ci/suites.json", "language-steps": ["python"], "pinned-tools": ["node", "gitleaks"]}.

language-steps.description: The language steps that the first Linux shard runs outside the recording when a change reaches their files.

pinned-tools.description: The pinned tools that the suite jobs give as setups at the version of the pins file, to the entry files that state them.
